title_hi: संबद्धता: अध्ययन वास्तव में क्या मापते हैं?
topic: belonging, perceived connection, social contact, perceived support, loneliness, belonging uncertainty, and downstream outcomes
unique_angle: Belonging research separates a felt sense of fit from contact counts, perceived support, loneliness, intervention processes, and downstream outcomes rather than using one universal social-connection meter.
evidence_class: peer-reviewed conceptual, social-connectedness, and randomized social-belonging intervention research
safety_boundary: Public education only. Belonging, contact, support, loneliness, intervention processes, and outcomes are context-bound constructs; they are not diagnosis, moral ranking, direct thought reading, or proof of a universal social trait.
